title: Lab Retention and Lens Cancellation Refund Calculation for Northgate Optical
content:
For a Northgate Optical job cancelled while in the lab, the lab retention and the lens cancellation refund are calculated on the job's lens charges.

**Lens charge pool.** The lens charge pool is the base-lens charge, the material upgrade charge and every light-adaptive, blue-light filtering or anti-reflective option charge of the job, each less every credit already posted against it. The base-lens and material upgrade charges are those of the original order (remake number 0).

**Lab retention.** The lab retention is the lab retention percentage of the lens charge pool, plus a lab cancellation fee of 5.00. The lab retention percentage is the in-lab retained percentage of the job's lens design. The lab retention is worked out in this order: the lowerings are taken off the lab retention percentage, never below zero; the lens charge pool is multiplied by the resulting percentage; the lab cancellation fee is then added.

**Lens cancellation refund.** The lens cancellation refund is the base-lens charge less every credit already posted against it, less the lab retention, never less than zero, rounded to the cent once at the end.

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Lab retention percentage | the in-lab retained percentage of the job's lens design |
| Retention loyalty lowering | 0 percentage points |
| Card spend lowering | 0 percentage points |
| Lab cancellation fee | 5.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical jobs)

**Job 1 — Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses (in-lab retained percentage 50 percent).** Base-lens charge 99.99 with a vision plan allowance of 44.99: net 55.00. Material upgrade and option charges all fully credited: net 0.00. Pool 55.00. Retention: 55.00 multiplied by 50 percent is 27.50, plus 5.00, is 32.50. Refund: 55.00 less 32.50 is 22.50.

**Job 2 — Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses (in-lab retained percentage 100 percent).** Base-lens charge 169.99, no credits, no other lens charges. Pool 169.99. Retention 169.99 plus 5.00 is 174.99, which exceeds the net base-lens charge: refund 0.00.

**Job 3 — Northgate Single Vision Lenses (50 percent).** Base-lens charge 39.99 with a 19.99 allowance: net 20.00. Material upgrade charge net 10.00 after a refund. Pool 30.00. Retention 15.00 plus 5.00 is 20.00. Refund 0.00.
